property_summary: For all inputs, C.transfer reverts when given an empty _tos array (require(_tos.length > 0)), but the mutant allowing length >= 0 will NOT revert for at least one input (an empty array), so the property is: calling transfer with an empty array always reverts; the mutant breaks this by returning true instead of reverting.
change_summary: Change the require that _tos.length > 0 to require _tos.length >= 0 (always true) so calls proceed when _tos is empty, causing different revert behavior between original and mutant.
